text:
sara: quick heads-up — streaming responses stopped mid-chunk after a short mobile network hiccup. sampleapp shows missing final JSON token and no resume. repro steps below.

jin: i hit this on iOS too earlier today. looks like we drop the last buffered fragment when the socket resets.

alex: can you paste logs? is it an ERR_CONNECTION_RESET or ECONNRESET?

sara: logs: 
```
stream: received chunk 1/3
stream: received chunk 2/3
ERROR: socket hang up (ECONNRESET)
stream: connection closed before final delimiter
```

matt: fwiw JS SDK currently treats an abrupt close as terminal unless we have a resume token persisted. python SDK will try resume within a small window — possible parity gap.

priya: @matt that matches what i saw. JS path parses chunks as they arrive and only writes `lastEventId` after a completed `data:` frame; if the final frame is partial we never persist it.

sara: repro steps i used:
```
# reproduce with curl by killing connection mid-stream
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream | head -c 1500 &
sleep 0.5; pkill -f "curl -N"
```

jin: nice repro. i also tried with our mobile network flakiness emulator and saw same failure.

alex: sounds like two problems: 1) parser needs to flush partial frames to disk (or keep lastEventId sooner), 2) resume/backoff policy should attempt a quick resume when reset happens within X ms.

matt: i'll prototype a small fix in the JS SDK: flush `lastEventId` as soon as we see a `data:` header that contains an id field, and attempt a resume if we get ECONNRESET within 1s of last chunk. will open PR.

priya: also update sampleapp to persist `lastEventId` in IndexedDB so mobile web can retry after transient disconnects.

sara: thanks — can you include a unit test that simulates a split chunk boundary? that's been flaky in the parsers in the past.

matt: yup, adding tests for: partial final chunk, duplicate resume token, and delayed `:heartbeat` lines.

matt: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-js-sdk/pull/1402 — includes parser change + resume window logic + test harness. cc @priya @jin

deploy-bot: CI green for PR #1402. deploy to staging requested by matt.

jin: can we also add a small log field `resume_attempted` in telemetry for these cases so we can measure occurrence in prod?

priya: agreed. add event `stream_resume_attempt` with reason=ECONNRESET and last_chunk_age_ms.

matt: added telemetry to PR. i'll update sampleapp demo and write a short devex doc snippet on how to reproduce with `tcpkill` + `curl`.

sara: testing on iOS now. will report back in this thread with results. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

jin: if i don't hear back by EOD i'll run a quick canary on staging.

sara: quick follow-up: on iOS the fix looks good — resume succeeded twice in a row. leaving in prod canary for a bit.

matt: great — following up to get the PR merged and a staged rollout. once merged i'll ping #eng-runtime for a rollout.

deploy-bot: PR #1402 merged and scheduled for canary deploy to staging at 2026-03-24T02:15:00Z.

alex: awesome — thanks team. remotely filing a small docs blurb about SDK parity and known streaming caveats.

sara: closing the loop here — repro steps + fix + staging canary confirmed. will open a follow-up if we see new flakiness.
